title: Not impressed
text: Not impressed. For the plus side, this blender looks wonderful in my stainless steel kitchen. For the negative side, too expensive, too noisy, cheap plastic lid, doesn't work as well as my other Oster blender which is less than half the cost. If you are looking for something sleek and modern and beautiful to look at this is it. It does blend ok, but as I mentioned not like my cheaper blender. Look elsewhere.

product_metadata.title: Cuisinart CBT-700 PowerEdge Die-Cast 700-Watt Blender
features: Die-cast metal housing with backlit functions
Dishwasher safe 56-ounce; glass easy-pour blender jar
Pre-programmed smoothie and ice crush functions
Product Built to North American Electrical Standards
description: With the CuisinartPowerEdge700-Blender, you can make tasty smoothies and great drinks or create gourmet soups and sauces. This blender is the ideal combination of power and performance with our new Power6 Turbo-Edge blade designed to crush ice, puree and mix with maximum efficiency. The timing will always be perfect with a built-in Count-UpTimer, and a great smoothie is just 30-second away with the pre-programmed Smoothie function. The 56-ounce. blender jar and lid are dishwasher safe for easy cleanup.
